_README: Canonical name map: FINANCE-SHEET / VENDOR NAME (left)  ->  DASHBOARD DISPLAY NAME (right). When a vendor appears in the GL or App-spend-totals tab under a name you want shown differently on the dashboard, add an entry here. The monthly build reads this file and renames apps accordingly. To add a new rename, add a line: "Name as it appears in finance sheet": "Name to show on dashboard". Keep names exactly as they appear in the source (case-sensitive).
_vendor_aliases_README: These are RAW GL/bank-descriptor strings that map to a single app. Used when parsing the GL so that e.g. all PEARSON VUE / VUE*COMPTIA lines roll up into one 'Comptia' line. Left = substring found in the GL 'Name' or 'Memo' column; right = app name (which is then passed through name_map above for final display).
_non_saas_exclude_README: Substrings/vendors that are NOT SaaS and should be dropped from the dashboard entirely (e.g. food delivery, reimbursements).
